summary: Cal-Maine Foods filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with BMO Bank and other lenders, effective August 31, 2026. The senior unsecured revolving credit facility provides up to $250 million (with $25 million sublimits for standby letters of credit and swingline loans), and an accordion feature to increase capacity by up to $250 million. Proceeds support general working capital, capex, permitted acquisitions, and fees. No amounts were borrowed as of September 1, 2026; $5.9 million letters of credit were drawn. Facility matures August 31, 2031, with customary covenants and financial tests. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
